claim_boundary: A two-window pass supports only a replicated Binance BTC/ETH 21:00-23:00 UTC expected-return regularity net of standard taker fees on frozen 2020-2021 and 2022Q2-2023 calendars. Familywise-error language is scoped only to post-policy cycles. It does not prove causality, does not establish future persistence, live executability, slippage-inclusive profitability, deployment readiness, capital allocation, or an absolute breakthrough, and does not by itself reach the 40%-per-year program target.

gate_descriptions.G1_net_magnitude: pooled mean net >= 0.0003 (three basis points per date; roughly 11% simple annual sum, more than one quarter of the 40%-per-year program target must survive costs)
gate_descriptions.G2_net_asset_consistency: BTCUSDT mean net > 0 AND ETHUSDT mean net > 0
gate_descriptions.G3_quarter_stability: at least 60% of included calendar quarters have strictly positive pooled mean net
gate_descriptions.G4_concentration: pooled mean x > 0 AND BTCUSDT mean x > 0 AND ETHUSDT mean x > 0
gate_descriptions.G5_dependence_robustness: p_net < 0.004166666666666667 AND p_x < 0.004166666666666667 under the frozen paired date-block bootstrap
gate_descriptions.fail_rule: If minimum sample is met and any gate is false, the mechanism is falsified on that window.
gate_descriptions.inconclusive_rule: Only frozen missing/duplicate/nonpositive-bar rejections reducing the paired sample below minimum yield an inconclusive result. Contract, audit, policy, inventory, checksum, CRC, member, first-row form, or schema failures abort without an artifact. UNKNOWN never passes.
gate_descriptions.pass_rule: A window passes only if its minimum sample is met and G1 through G5 are all true; all gates are conjunctive.

result.reason: at least one frozen gate is false

window.relation_to_source: inside the published 2015-10..2022-02 sample; different venue, instrument, and costs
